style_guide.lighting: Soft natural indoor daylight, matching the canonical smartphone capture profile; believable household shadows and restrained HDR.
style_guide.camera_style: Realistic modern-smartphone documentation photography, 26 mm-equivalent main-camera look, stable geometry across multi-view references.
style_guide.environment: Ordinary modern home kitchen / utility area with neutral wall, light floor and restrained cabinetry.
style_guide.color_notes: Neutral household colors; refrigerator remains dark charcoal matte/satin coated metal.

entities.name: Canonical refrigerator
entities.canonical_description: Dark charcoal freestanding two-door top-freezer refrigerator, designed as one believable mass-produced household appliance and locked first through an AI-generated multi-view reference pack.

visual_properties.baseline_view: multi-view reference pack; rear-left/rear-right 45° preferred for rear-heat scenes

invariant_features: upper freezer door smaller than lower fresh-food door
same recessed vertical left-edge handle geometry
same feet, panel seams, edge radii and door thickness across views
allowed_variations: select a different approved A0 reference view for the target camera direction
forbidden_variations: change to white or stainless-steel finish
change to French-door, side-by-side or bottom-freezer layout
change door count, divider position, handle design or cabinet proportions
replace with a different refrigerator model
invent hidden technical components merely for visual convenience
use CGI/showroom styling that conflicts with the smartphone-realistic reference pack
